dimensions.assessment: Affects states, tribes, local air agencies, and entities eligible for Clean Air Act grants or smoke hazard mitigation funding.
dimensions.evidence: Eligible entities for a grant under subsection (a) are-- (1) States; (2) federally recognized Indian Tribes

dimensions.assessment: Changes air quality monitoring petition rules and enables competitive grant funding for community building smoke hazards.
dimensions.evidence: competitive grants under section 103(b)(3) of the Clean Air Act... for the assessment, prevention, control, or abatement of wildfire smoke hazards

dimensions.assessment: Subject to the availability of appropriations, establishes grant funding where the federal cost share is up to 90 percent.
dimensions.evidence: Subject to the availability of appropriations, the Administrator... may make competitive grants

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Clean Air Act regarding exceptional events and prescribed fires, and creates a smoke ready communities grant program.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the Clean Air Act to modify the handling of air quality monitoring with respect to prescribed fires, and for other purposes.

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory amendments to the Clean Air Act combined with ongoing grant authorization provisions.

missing_information: Specific authorized dollar amounts for the grant program
Total number of communities or buildings expected to receive grants
importance_detail.rationale: The bill modifies Clean Air Act procedures for prescribed fires and exceptional events and establishes a competitive grant program for wildfire smoke hazards in community buildings, subject to available appropriations.
